# [April April] First DLSS5 screenshots of Fallout 76 surfaced

![\[April April\] First DLSS5 screenshots of Fallout 76 surfaced](/uploads/668_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update April 2nd, 2026] Of course it was an April Fool's joke, the screenshots are not real.

It was only announced on the last Fallout Day 2025 that the next generation versions of Fallout 76 for consoles can be expected at the beginning of 2026. Unfortunately there is no further information about this so far, we are eagerly waiting for a concrete date.

But there is other news:

Maybe you've already heard of DLSS 5? An AI-based new development from Nvidia to graphically improve existing games in real time. You can find more information about Nvidia DLSS 5 here.

## DLSS 5 in Fallout 76

We have screenshots that demonstrate what Fallout 76 can look like with DLSS 5. And of course we don't want to withhold that from you.
